Node Annotator (node-annotator) Owner: CoCoWG Status: Continues into Refactor Registered in SmartAPI without an infores, and its ci/test servers carry no x-maturity and are declared http:// not https://. SmartAPI registers it at biothings.ci.transltr.io/annotator, which does not serve the OpenAPI document; annotator.ci.transltr.io does. Both were live on 2026-08-31, so the ci base URL is recorded here rather than pulled. Prod serves its OpenAPI at openapi.json rather than the webapp/openapi.json that ci and test use, so it carries a per-environment override; ci and test are the intended convention going forward.
